     9	/-!
    10	# AT GENUS `0` THE `pic⁰` MEMBERSHIP CONDITION IS FIBREWISE TRIVIALITY
    11	
    12	`hvan : ∀ T, Subsingleton (pic0Subgroup C T)` is the hypothesis both live routes to a producer
    13	of `(pic0TypeFunctor C).RepresentableBy` pass through, and it had no instance.  Its field
    14	instances were closed at genus `0`, and the surviving ring instances were priced as
    15	"cohomology and base change".
    16	
    17	At `genus C = 0` the hypothesis — at *every* test object, not merely affine ones — is
    18	*equivalent* to
    19	
    20	  **`hrig`: a `picEt` class that restricts to `1` at every field point of `T` is `1`.**
    21	
    22	The equivalence is `pic0Vanishing_iff_rigidity` below, proved in both directions.
    23	
    24	## WHAT THIS IS, STATED HONESTLY — the original framing was wrong
    25	
    26	**An earlier version of this header called the equivalence a *repricing* and said "the degree
    27	condition is provably idle at genus `0`".  A fresh-context audit (`I-1650`, `I-1653`) refuted
    28	that, and the refutation is worth more than the claim was.**
    29	
    30	At genus `0`, for every `T` and every `lam`, the antecedent of `hrig` and membership in
    31	`pic0Subgroup C T` are *equivalent* — forward by `degAt_one` after rewriting the restriction to
    32	`1`, backward by `fibre_eq_one_of_mem_pic0Subgroup` below.  So `hrig` is `hvan` **with the same
    33	predicate written differently**: `= 1` in place of `deg = 0`.  The degree left the notation, not
    34	the mathematics.  The tell was visible in this file all along — `rigidity_of_pic0Vanishing`
    35	needs *no genus hypothesis*, and a genuinely weaker target does not round-trip for free.
    36	
    37	**What the new spelling does buy, and it is not nothing.**  `classDeg` carries five instance
    38	binders on the fibre curve (`IsIntegral`, `SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1`, `QuasiCompact`, and
    39	both `Module.Finite` Betti-number clauses) which do not synthesize through the `relCurve` `def`
    40	barrier — all five measured as genuinely required.  The triviality spelling needs none of them,
    41	so hypotheses that could not be *stated* at a general prime become statable.  That is a
    42	**statability** gain, not a reduction of the obligation.
    43	
    44	`fibre_eq_one_of_mem_pic0Subgroup` is the direction that is reusable on its own: a degree-zero
    45	class at genus `0` is fibrewise trivial at every field point of **any** test object, with no
    46	affineness.  It is what pic-g's ring-level engine work consumes.
    47	
    48	## The converse, and why it is worth stating
    49	
    50	`hrig` is not merely sufficient.  `rigidity_of_pic0Vanishing` derives it *from* the vanishing,
    51	because a class trivial at every field point has `degAt` equal to `0` there
    52	(`degAt_one` after transporting along the restriction), hence lies in `pic0Subgroup`, hence is
    53	`1` when that group is trivial.  So the two are the same hypothesis and no strength is lost by
    54	attacking `hrig` instead — the bundled equivalence is `pic0Vanishing_iff_rigidity`.
    55	
    56	## What this does NOT do
    57	
    58	* **It does not prove `hrig`, at any curve**, and — per the correction above — `hrig` is not a
    59	  *smaller* obligation than `hvan`, only a differently spelled one.  `ℙ¹` gains no instance
    60	  from this file.
    61	* **It does not make `hrig` cheap.**  Field-point separation of `picEt` has no producer in the
    62	  tree either — `PicEtAff.unit_injective` and `relPicAlgMap_injective_of_etaleCover` are
    63	  separation along *étale covers*, which is a different family of test maps, and a field point
    64	  is not an étale cover of `A` unless `A` is already a field.
    65	* **It says nothing at positive genus**, where the forward direction fails at its only step:
    66	  the field-test vanishing it consumes is false there.
    67	
    68	## Main declarations
    69	
    70	* `AlgebraicGeometry.fibre_eq_one_of_mem_pic0Subgroup` — **the reusable half**: at genus `0`, a
    71	  degree-zero class restricts to `1` at every field point of any test object.
    72	* `AlgebraicGeometry.subsingleton_pic0Subgroup_of_rigidity` — **the reduction**: field-point
    73	  rigidity of `picEt` gives the vanishing at every test.
    74	* `AlgebraicGeometry.rigidity_of_pic0Vanishing` — the converse.
    75	* `AlgebraicGeometry.pic0Vanishing_iff_rigidity` — the equivalence: the two spellings of the
    76	  hypothesis are one hypothesis.
    77	* `AlgebraicGeometry.P1.subsingleton_pic0Subgroup_of_rigidity` — the reduction at `ℙ¹`, with the
    78	  genus hypothesis discharged, so the statement has a witness curve.
    79	-/
    80	
    81	set_option autoImplicit false
    82	
    83	universe u
    84	
    85	open CategoryTheory Limits MonoidalCategory CartesianMonoidalCategory
    86	
    87	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    88	
    89	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
    90	variable [IsProper C.hom] [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom]
    91	variable [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] [GeometricallyReduced C.hom]
    92	
    93	noncomputable section
    94	
    95	/-! ## The forward step: the degree condition is spent here, and only here -/
    96	
    97	/-- **A DEGREE-ZERO CLASS IS FIBREWISE TRIVIAL AT GENUS `0`**, at every field point of every
    98	test object.
    99	
   100	This is the one step that consumes the degree condition.  `pic0Map C t` restricts a
   101	degree-zero class to a *degree-zero* class of the field test — that stability is definitional
   102	through `degAt_picEtMap` — and at a field test the group is a `Subsingleton` by the landed
   103	`subsingleton_pic0Subgroup_overSpec_field_of_genus_zero`, so the restriction is `1` by
   104	`Subsingleton.elim`.  Nothing else in this file mentions a degree.
   105	
   106	No affineness on `T`: the test object is arbitrary. -/
   107	theorem fibre_eq_one_of_mem_pic0Subgroup (hg : genus C = 0) {T : Over (Spec (.of k))}
   108	    (lam : pic0Subgroup C T) (K : Type u) [Field K] [Algebra k K] (t : overSpec k K ⟶ T) :
   109	    picEtMap C t (lam : picEt C T) = 1 := by
   110	  haveI : Subsingleton (pic0Subgroup C (overSpec k K)) :=
   111	    subsingleton_pic0Subgroup_overSpec_field_of_genus_zero C K hg
   112	  have h1 : pic0Map C t lam = 1 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
   113	  have h2 := congrArg
   114	    (fun z : pic0Subgroup C (overSpec k K) => (z : picEt C (overSpec k K))) h1
   115	  simpa [pic0Map_coe] using h2
   116	
   117	/-! ## The reduction, and its converse -/
   118	
   119	/-- **THE REDUCTION**: at genus `0`, field-point rigidity of `picEt` gives the `pic⁰` vanishing
   120	at **every** test object.
   121	
   122	`hrig`'s statement carries no degree, no χ, no divisor and no chart — it is separation of the
   123	presheaf `picEt C ·` against field points.  The proof is `fibre_eq_one_of_mem_pic0Subgroup` fed
   124	to `hrig`, twice.  (Per `I-1650`: the *hypothesis* is nonetheless the same one, so this is a
   125	change of spelling with a statability payoff, not a discount.) -/
   126	theorem subsingleton_pic0Subgroup_of_rigidity (hg : genus C = 0)
   127	    (hrig : ∀ (T : Over (Spec (.of k))) (lam : picEt C T),
   128	      (∀ (K : Type u) [Field K] [Algebra k K] (t : overSpec k K ⟶ T),
   129	        picEtMap C t lam = 1) → lam = 1)
   130	    (T : Over (Spec (.of k))) : Subsingleton (pic0Subgroup C T) := by
   131	  refine ⟨fun s t => Subtype.ext ?_⟩
   132	  have key : ∀ w : pic0Subgroup C T, (w : picEt C T) = 1 := fun w =>
   133	    hrig T _ fun K _ _ tp => fibre_eq_one_of_mem_pic0Subgroup C hg w K tp
   134	  rw [key s, key t]
   135	
   136	/-- **THE CONVERSE**: the vanishing gives field-point rigidity.
   137	
   138	A class trivial at every field point has `degAt` equal to `0` at every field point — rewrite
   139	the restriction to `1` and apply `degAt_one` — so it lies in `pic0Subgroup C T`, which the
   140	hypothesis makes trivial.  Note this direction needs **no** genus hypothesis. -/
   141	theorem rigidity_of_pic0Vanishing
   142	    (hvan : ∀ T : Over (Spec (.of k)), Subsingleton (pic0Subgroup C T))
   143	    (T : Over (Spec (.of k))) (lam : picEt C T)
   144	    (h : ∀ (K : Type u) [Field K] [Algebra k K] (t : overSpec k K ⟶ T),
   145	      picEtMap C t lam = 1) : lam = 1 := by
   146	  haveI := hvan T
   147	  have hmem : lam ∈ pic0Subgroup C T := by
   148	    intro K _ _ t
   149	    rw [degAt, h K t, map_one, PicEtAff.degAff_one]
   150	  have : (⟨lam, hmem⟩ : pic0Subgroup C T) = 1 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
   151	  exact congrArg (fun z : pic0Subgroup C T => (z : picEt C T)) this
   152	
   153	/-- **THE EQUIVALENCE**: at genus `0` the vanishing at every test is exactly field-point
   154	rigidity of `picEt`.
   155	
   156	Read it as what it is: the *same* hypothesis in two spellings, not a smaller one.  A lane may
   157	take the rigidity form without weakening anything — and the reason to do so is mechanical, that
   158	`classDeg`'s five fibre instances drop out of the statement, not that the obligation shrinks
   159	(`I-1650`). -/
   160	theorem pic0Vanishing_iff_rigidity (hg : genus C = 0) :
   161	    (∀ T : Over (Spec (.of k)), Subsingleton (pic0Subgroup C T))
   162	      ↔ ∀ (T : Over (Spec (.of k))) (lam : picEt C T),
   163	          (∀ (K : Type u) [Field K] [Algebra k K] (t : overSpec k K ⟶ T),
   164	            picEtMap C t lam = 1) → lam = 1 :=
   165	  ⟨rigidity_of_pic0Vanishing C, subsingleton_pic0Subgroup_of_rigidity C hg⟩
   166	
   167	/-! ## Non-vacuity: the reduction fires at a curve -/
   168	
   169	/-- **The reduction at `ℙ¹`, with the genus hypothesis discharged.**
   170	
   171	`Curve/P1Curve.lean` gives `P1.asOver k` the curve binders over an arbitrary field and
   172	`Curve/P1H1Vanishing.lean` gives `genus (P1.asOver k) = 0`, so at `ℙ¹` the *only* thing between
   173	this project and a `JacobianData` through `jacobianData_of_subsingleton` is field-point rigidity
   174	of `picEt (P1.asOver k) ·`.  Recorded because a conditional statement whose antecedent has no
   175	witness curve is worth nothing, and this one has one. -/
   176	theorem P1.subsingleton_pic0Subgroup_of_rigidity (k' : Type u) [Field k']
   177	    (hrig : ∀ (T : Over (Spec (.of k'))) (lam : picEt (P1.asOver k') T),
   178	      (∀ (K : Type u) [Field K] [Algebra k' K] (t : overSpec k' K ⟶ T),
   179	        picEtMap (P1.asOver k') t lam = 1) → lam = 1)
   180	    (T : Over (Spec (.of k'))) : Subsingleton (pic0Subgroup (P1.asOver k') T) :=

     8	/-!
     9	# The section rank at a chart-locus point
    10	
    11	`Pic0ChartLocusH0One` specializes the chart parameter to the genus and obtains the
    12	unique-effective-representative value `h⁰ = 1`.  This file records the unspecialized
    13	calculation.  If the chart parameter is `n` and the curve has Euler characteristic
    14	`1 - g`, the vanishing witness extracted from `chartLocus` has
    15	
    16	`h⁰ = n + 1 - g`.
    17	
    18	This separates two roles that a coverage argument must not conflate: a large parameter can
    19	force `H¹`-vanishing, while the injective Abel chart needs the genus parameter, where the
    20	same rank formula becomes `h⁰ = 1`.
    21	-/
    22	
    23	set_option autoImplicit false
    24	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false

    44	
    45	/-- Chart-locus membership at parameter `n` supplies a witness of section rank `n + 1 - g` on a
    46	curve with Euler characteristic `1 - g`.
    47	
    48	The conclusion retains the presentation, divisor-class, degree, and vanishing clauses from
    49	`IsSplitWitness`; consequently it is tied to the given class and cannot be inhabited by an
    50	unrelated trivial divisor. -/
    51	theorem exists_splitting_h0_formula_of_mem_chartLocus
    52	    {T : Over (Spec (.of k))} (lam : picEt C T) (t : T.left)
    53	    (m : ℕ) (Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor) (n g : ℕ)
    54	    (hdeg : Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg k Z
    55	      = (m : ℤ) * classDeg k (thetaCechClass C) - (n : ℤ))
    56	    (hχ : Sheaf.chi (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) = 1 - (g : ℤ))
    57	    (hlam : degAt lam (Over.testPoint t) = 0)
    58	    (ht : t ∈ chartLocus C m Z lam) :
    59	    ∃ (L : Type u) (_ : Field L) (_ : Algebra k L) (_ : Algebra (Over.testPointField t) L)
    60	        (_ : IsScalarTower k (Over.testPointField t) L)
    61	        (_ : Module.Finite (Over.testPointField t) L)
    62	        (_ : Algebra.IsSeparable (Over.testPointField t) L)
    63	        (M : (relCurve C L).CechPic)
    64	        (W : ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left).CurveDivisor),
    65	      PicEtAff.map C L
    66	          (picEtAffineEquiv C (Over.testPointField t)
    67	            (picEtMap C (Over.testPoint t) (chartTwist C m Z T lam)))
    68	        = PicEtAff.unit C L (relPicMk C (overSpec k L) M) ∧
    69	      Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass L W = M ∧
    70	      Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg L W = (n : ℤ) ∧
    71	      Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule
    72	        ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left.divisorSheaf L W) 1) ∧
    73	      (Sheaf.h0 ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left.divisorSheaf L W) : ℤ)
    74	        = (n : ℤ) + 1 - (g : ℤ) := by
    75	  obtain ⟨L, hLf, hLa, hLKa, hLtow, hLfin, hLsep, M, hM, W, hWcl, hWh1⟩ := ht
    76	  haveI : IsIntegral (relCurve C L) := instIsIntegralBaseChange C L
    77	  haveI : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (relCurve C L ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of L)) :=
    78	    instSmoothOfRelativeDimensionBaseChange C L
    79	  haveI : QuasiCompact (relCurve C L ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of L)) :=
    80	    instQuasiCompactBaseChange C L
    81	  haveI : Module.Finite L (Sheaf.HModule ((relCurve C L).moduleKSheaf L) 0) :=
    82	    instModuleFiniteHModuleZeroBaseChange C L
    83	  haveI : Module.Finite L (Sheaf.HModule ((relCurve C L).moduleKSheaf L) 1) :=
    84	    instModuleFiniteHModuleOneBaseChange C L
    85	  have hWdeg : Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg L W = (n : ℤ) := by
    86	    rw [← classDeg_picClass (K := L) W, hWcl,
    87	      classDeg_presenting_eq_degAff C L _ M hM]
    88	    change degAt (chartTwist C m Z T lam) (Over.testPoint t) = (n : ℤ)
    89	    rw [chartTwist, degAt_mul, degAt_inv, degAt_mul, degAt_thetaFamily_pow,
    90	      degAt_sigmaFamily, hlam, hdeg]
    91	    ring
    92	  have hχL : Sheaf.chi (((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left).moduleKSheaf L) = 1 - (g : ℤ) :=
    93	    chi_relCurve_baseField C L g hχ
    94	  have hrank := h0_eq_deg_add_chi_of_subsingleton_hModule_one (K := L) W hWh1
    95	  rw [hWdeg, hχL] at hrank
    96	  refine ⟨L, hLf, hLa, hLKa, hLtow, hLfin, hLsep, M, W, hM, hWcl, hWdeg, hWh1, ?_⟩
    97	  omega

    99	/-- Above the genus parameter, chart-locus membership supplies a witness with at least two
   100	sections.  Thus the
   101	large-parameter vanishing route and the `h⁰ = 1` uniqueness route are genuinely different
   102	branches of the representability argument. -/
   103	theorem exists_splitting_two_le_h0_of_mem_chartLocus
   104	    {T : Over (Spec (.of k))} (lam : picEt C T) (t : T.left)
   105	    (m : ℕ) (Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor) (n g : ℕ)
   106	    (hdeg : Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg k Z
   107	      = (m : ℤ) * classDeg k (thetaCechClass C) - (n : ℤ))
   108	    (hχ : Sheaf.chi (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) = 1 - (g : ℤ))
   109	    (hlam : degAt lam (Over.testPoint t) = 0) (hgn : g < n)
   110	    (ht : t ∈ chartLocus C m Z lam) :
   111	    ∃ (L : Type u) (_ : Field L) (_ : Algebra k L) (_ : Algebra (Over.testPointField t) L)
   112	        (_ : IsScalarTower k (Over.testPointField t) L)
   113	        (_ : Module.Finite (Over.testPointField t) L)
   114	        (_ : Algebra.IsSeparable (Over.testPointField t) L)
   115	        (M : (relCurve C L).CechPic)
   116	        (W : ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left).CurveDivisor),
   117	      PicEtAff.map C L
   118	          (picEtAffineEquiv C (Over.testPointField t)
   119	            (picEtMap C (Over.testPoint t) (chartTwist C m Z T lam)))
   120	        = PicEtAff.unit C L (relPicMk C (overSpec k L) M) ∧
   121	      Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass L W = M ∧
   122	      Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg L W = (n : ℤ) ∧
   123	      Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule
   124	        ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left.divisorSheaf L W) 1) ∧
   125	      2 ≤ Sheaf.h0 ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left.divisorSheaf L W) := by
   126	  obtain ⟨L, hLf, hLa, hLKa, hLtow, hLfin, hLsep, M, W, hM, hWcl, hWdeg, hWh1,
   127	      hrank⟩ := exists_splitting_h0_formula_of_mem_chartLocus
   128	        lam t m Z n g hdeg hχ hlam ht
   129	  refine ⟨L, hLf, hLa, hLKa, hLtow, hLfin, hLsep, M, W, hM, hWcl, hWdeg, hWh1, ?_⟩
   130	  have htwo : (2 : ℤ) ≤
   131	      (Sheaf.h0 ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left.divisorSheaf L W) : ℤ) := by
   132	    rw [hrank]
   133	    omega
   134	  exact_mod_cast htwo

   136	/-! ## The actual unconditional coverage parameter -/
   137	
   138	/-- On a positive-genus curve, the unconditional admissible coverage parameter is strictly
   139	larger than the genus.
   140	
   141	The strictness does not add a cohomological hypothesis: `h⁰(𝒪_C) = 1` follows from the standing
   142	proper, smooth, geometrically irreducible assumptions.  If the ledger contribution above `g`
   143	were nonpositive, `genus_eq_zero_of_windowBound_nonpos` would contradict `g ≠ 0`. -/
   144	theorem genus_lt_admissibleCoverageParameter_of_ne_zero
   145	    {π : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsFinite π] [IsDominant π]
   146	    (hπ : π ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.hom)
   147	    (g : ℕ) (hg : g ≠ 0)
   148	    (hχ : Sheaf.chi (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) = 1 - (g : ℤ)) :
   149	    letI : C.left.Over (Spec (.of k)) := ⟨C.hom⟩
   150	    haveI : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k)) :=
   151	      inferInstanceAs (SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom)
   152	    haveI : IsIntegral C.left := isIntegral_left_of_geometricallyReduced C
   153	    haveI : LocallyOfFiniteType (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k)) :=
   154	      inferInstanceAs (LocallyOfFiniteType C.hom)
   155	    haveI : QuasiCompact (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k)) :=
   156	      inferInstanceAs (QuasiCompact C.hom)
   157	    haveI : Module.Finite k (Sheaf.HModule (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) 0) :=
   158	      moduleFinite_hModule_zero C
   159	    haveI : Module.Finite k (Sheaf.HModule (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) 1) :=
   160	      moduleFinite_hModule_one C
   161	    g < admissibleCoverageParameter (C := C) hπ g := by
   162	  letI : C.left.Over (Spec (.of k)) := ⟨C.hom⟩
   163	  haveI : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k)) :=
   164	    inferInstanceAs (SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom)
   165	  haveI : IsIntegral C.left := isIntegral_left_of_geometricallyReduced C
   166	  haveI : LocallyOfFiniteType (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k)) :=
   167	    inferInstanceAs (LocallyOfFiniteType C.hom)
   168	  haveI : QuasiCompact (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k)) :=
   169	    inferInstanceAs (QuasiCompact C.hom)
   170	  haveI : Module.Finite k (Sheaf.HModule (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) 0) :=
   171	    moduleFinite_hModule_zero C
   172	  haveI : Module.Finite k (Sheaf.HModule (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) 1) :=
   173	    moduleFinite_hModule_one C
   174	  have hO : Sheaf.h0 (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) = 1 := h0_moduleKSheaf C
   175	  have hb : 0 < windowBound π hπ := by
   176	    by_contra hnonpos
   177	    exact hg (genus_eq_zero_of_windowBound_nonpos π hπ g
   178	      (not_lt.mp hnonpos) hO hχ)
   179	  have hM := windowBound_le_M_mul π hπ g
   180	  have hledger : (g : ℤ) <
   181	      (windowM_choice π hπ g : ℤ) * windowδ π + (g : ℤ) := by
   182	    omega
   183	  have hadmissible := ledgerBound_le_admissibleCoverageParameter (C := C) hπ g
   184	  have hcast : (g : ℤ) <
   185	      (admissibleCoverageParameter (C := C) hπ g : ℤ) :=
   186	    hledger.trans_le hadmissible
   187	  exact_mod_cast hcast

   189	/-- For positive genus, the uniform full-locus coverage chart supplies a splitting witness with
   190	at least two sections at every degree-zero fibre point.
   191	
   192	This is the direct join between `exists_uniform_admissibleCoverageChart` and the rank formula:
   193	the large parameter solves vanishing and coverage, but it cannot simultaneously be read as the
   194	genus-parameter `h⁰ = 1` chart used by the unique-effective-representative route. -/
   195	theorem exists_uniform_admissibleCoverageChart_two_le_h0
   196	    {π : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsFinite π] [IsDominant π]
   197	    (hπ : π ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.hom)
   198	    (g : ℕ) (hg : g ≠ 0)
   199	    (hχ : Sheaf.chi (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) = 1 - (g : ℤ)) :
   200	    letI : C.left.Over (Spec (.of k)) := ⟨C.hom⟩
   201	    haveI : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k)) :=
   202	      inferInstanceAs (SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom)
   203	    haveI : IsIntegral C.left := isIntegral_left_of_geometricallyReduced C
   204	    haveI : LocallyOfFiniteType (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k)) :=
   205	      inferInstanceAs (LocallyOfFiniteType C.hom)
   206	    haveI : QuasiCompact (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k)) :=
   207	      inferInstanceAs (QuasiCompact C.hom)
   208	    haveI : Module.Finite k (Sheaf.HModule (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) 0) :=
   209	      moduleFinite_hModule_zero C
   210	    haveI : Module.Finite k (Sheaf.HModule (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) 1) :=
   211	      moduleFinite_hModule_one C
   212	    ∃ (m : ℕ) (Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor),
   213	      Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg k Z
   214	          = (m : ℤ) * classDeg k (thetaCechClass C)
   215	            - (admissibleCoverageParameter (C := C) hπ g : ℤ) ∧
   216	        ∀ {T : Over (Spec (.of k))} (lam : picEt C T) (t : T.left),
   217	          degAt lam (Over.testPoint t) = 0 →
   218	            ∃ (L : Type u) (_ : Field L) (_ : Algebra k L)
   219	                (_ : Algebra (Over.testPointField t) L)
   220	                (_ : IsScalarTower k (Over.testPointField t) L)
   221	                (_ : Module.Finite (Over.testPointField t) L)
   222	                (_ : Algebra.IsSeparable (Over.testPointField t) L)
   223	                (M : (relCurve C L).CechPic)
   224	                (W : ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left).CurveDivisor),
   225	              PicEtAff.map C L
   226	                  (picEtAffineEquiv C (Over.testPointField t)
   227	                    (picEtMap C (Over.testPoint t) (chartTwist C m Z T lam)))
   228	                = PicEtAff.unit C L (relPicMk C (overSpec k L) M) ∧
   229	              Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass L W = M ∧
   230	              Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg L W
   231	                = (admissibleCoverageParameter (C := C) hπ g : ℤ) ∧
   232	              Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule
   233	                ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left.divisorSheaf L W) 1) ∧
   234	              2 ≤ Sheaf.h0 ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left.divisorSheaf L W) := by
   235	  letI : C.left.Over (Spec (.of k)) := ⟨C.hom⟩
   236	  haveI : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k)) :=
   237	    inferInstanceAs (SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom)
   238	  haveI : IsIntegral C.left := isIntegral_left_of_geometricallyReduced C
   239	  haveI : LocallyOfFiniteType (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k)) :=
   240	    inferInstanceAs (LocallyOfFiniteType C.hom)

   242	    inferInstanceAs (QuasiCompact C.hom)

   244	    moduleFinite_hModule_zero C

   246	    moduleFinite_hModule_one C

   249	  intro T lam t hlam

     9	/-!
    10	# The chart locus SUPPLIES GAP-2's binders rather than needing them
    11	
    12	Seven files cite the keystone by name (measured, case-insensitively, at HEAD: `Pic0ChartLocus`,
    13	`Pic0ChartUnivReduce`, `Pic0ChartPair`, `Pic0ChartAbelNonInjective`, `Pic0ChartAbelForkReduce`,
    14	`JacobianDataAbelDegreeWindow`, and `RiemannRoch/EffectiveUniqueness` itself); the chart-layer
    15	ones name the *relative form of DAT-C GAP-2* as the residue of
    16	`ChartFibrePresented.exists_factor` (`Pic0ChartOpenImmersionCriterion.lean:140`; that file is
    17	**outside this one's import closure**, so the name is unresolvable here and is cited by
    18	location rather than bare — `I-1173`), and price its field-level keystone
    19	`Scheme.CurveDivisor.eq_of_picClass_eq_of_h0_one` (`RiemannRoch/EffectiveUniqueness.lean:144`)
    20	as landed-but-unfed: what a lane still owes, they say, are that keystone's three binders
    21	`hD`, `hD'` (effectivity) and `hone` (`h⁰ = 1`).
    22	
    23	**On the chart locus all three are consequences.**  The reason is visible in the definition
    24	and was apparently never read off it: `chartLocus` is *defined* by the very vanishing the rank
    25	anchor consumes.  `IsSplitWitness` (`Pic0ChartLocus.lean:151`) asserts, at a point, the
    26	existence of a finite separable `L/κ(t)`, a presenting Čech class `M`, and a `CurveDivisor W`
    27	in that class with `Subsingleton H¹(𝒪(W))`.  So membership already carries a divisor with
    28	`h¹ = 0`; what it does not carry is that divisor's *degree*, and the degree comes from
    29	outside, from the chart-index constraint.
    30	
    31	## The chain, every link landed before this file
    32	
    33	1. `classDeg_presenting_eq_degAff` (`Pic0ChartCoverageDegreeStep2.lean:85`) reads the
    34	   `L`-degree of the presenting class as the plus-degree of the class it presents;
    35	2. the twist ledger (`chartTwist` unfolded through `degAt_mul`/`degAt_inv`/
    36	   `degAt_thetaFamily_pow`/`degAt_sigmaFamily`) turns that into `m·d₁ − deg_k Z`, which the
    37	   chart-index constraint `hdeg` makes exactly `n`;
    38	3. `chi_relCurve_baseField` transports `χ(𝒪) = 1 − n` to the base-changed curve;
    39	4. the rank anchor `h0_eq_deg_add_chi_of_subsingleton_hModule_one`
    40	   (`RiemannRoch/FLVClass.lean:412`) gives `h⁰ = deg + χ = n + (1 − n) = 1`;
    41	5. `exists_effective_of_h0_pos` (`RiemannRoch/SectionBound.lean:175`) then produces an
    42	   **effective** divisor of the same class, so effectivity is free too;
    43	6. `h0_divisorSheaf_eq_of_picClass_eq` (`RiemannRoch/ClassCohomology.lean:89`) carries the
    44	   `h⁰` value across to it.
    45	
    46	## What this is NOT
    47	
    48	* It is **not** `hb_forces_h0_eq_one` (`Pic0ChartCoverageIndexSlack.lean:180`).  That takes a
    49	  *threshold* hypothesis — every divisor of degree `≥ n` has `H¹ = 0` — which its own file
    50	  proves **false** at `n = g` (a moving degree-`g` family has `h⁰ ≥ 2`).  Nothing here assumes
    51	  a threshold: the vanishing is supplied by the locus at **one** divisor, the one the
    52	  membership witness names.  A statement about one divisor of degree `n` is not a statement
    53	  about all of them, and only the former is true.
    54	* It does **not** discharge `exists_factor`, and therefore closes no antecedent of
    55	  `pic0RepresentableByOfCharts`.  Everything here is **fibrewise**: it lives over a splitting
    56	  field `L/κ(t)` at a single point `t`.  Per the standing caveat of
    57	  `Pic0ChartAbelNonInjective.lean`, uniqueness of the *fibre* witness is not injectivity of
    58	  the chart at a general test — the gap measured as `RelPicSeparatesDivFamZar`
    59	  (`Pic0ChartAbelForkReduce.lean:237`, also outside this file's closure).  What is removed is
    60	  one *named input* of the field-level keystone, not the relativisation.
    61	* `n = genus C` is **not** proved here and is not assumed either: `n` is whatever the chart
    62	  index is legal at, and `hχ : χ(𝒪_C) = 1 − n` is a hypothesis.  Per `I-1176`,
    63	  `chi_moduleKSheaf` *converts* that pinning rather than supplying it, so the binder stays
    64	  explicit and its supplier stays named.
    65	
    66	## Main declarations
    67	
    68	* `h0_eq_one_of_subsingleton_of_deg` — the rank anchor at a witness of the pinned degree.
    69	* `exists_splitting_h0_eq_one_of_mem_chartLocus` — **the converse of
    70	  `mem_chartLocus_of_witness_h1`**: from locus membership, a witness with `h⁰ = 1`.
    71	* `eq_of_picClass_eq_of_deg_of_subsingleton` — the keystone with `hone` discharged.
    72	* `exists_effective_picClass_eq_of_h0_eq_one` — effectivity is free once `h⁰ = 1`.
    73	* `existsUnique_effective_of_mem_chartLocus` — **the payoff**: at a locus point the class has
    74	  an effective representative that is the unique one, with all three keystone binders supplied.
    75	-/

   391	    (f : A) (y : Q)

   393	      (y ⊗ₜ (1 : p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
   394	        Q ⊗[A] p.asIdeal.ResidueField) ≠ 0)
   395	    (q : PrimeSpectrum (Localization.Away f)) :
   396	    ((1 : q.asIdeal.ResidueField) ⊗ₜ[A] y :
   397	      q.asIdeal.ResidueField ⊗[A] Q) ≠ 0 := by
   398	  let p : PrimeSpectrum A :=
   399	    PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap A (Localization.Away f)) q

   401	    intro hf
   402	    refine q.isPrime.ne_top (Ideal.eq_top_of_isUnit_mem q.asIdeal
   403	      (Ideal.mem_comap.mp hf) ?_)

   405	  have hp : ((1 : p.asIdeal.ResidueField) ⊗ₜ[A] y :
   406	      p.asIdeal.ResidueField ⊗[A] Q) ≠ 0 := by
   407	    have h := (TensorProduct.comm A Q p.asIdeal.ResidueField).map_ne_zero_iff.mpr
   408	      (hy p hfp)

   411	      q.asIdeal.comap (algebraMap A (Localization.Away f)) := rfl

   414	      (Algebra.ofId A (Localization.Away f)) hcom

   416	    (RingHom.surjectiveOnStalks_of_isLocalization (Submonoid.powers f)
   417	      (Localization.Away f)).residueFieldMap_bijective

   419	  let e : p.asIdeal.ResidueField ≃ₗ[A] q.asIdeal.ResidueField :=

   583	/-- A rank-one presentation has a tied local-away evaluation generator.
   584	
   585	The rank-one field of `P` makes every residue-field fibre of its `H⁰` module nontrivial.
   586	The projective-module generator lemma therefore supplies a single basic open `D(f)` and
   587	one datum section `y` which stays nonzero on every residue fibre over that open.  The same
   588	`y` is transported to a native global section and its unit-lift through the evaluation
   589	counit; the final conjunct records that counit identity explicitly so the future
   590	`divisorOfRankOne` construction consumes this witness rather than an unrelated section.
   591	-/
   592	theorem exists_baseOpen_evaluation_generator
   593	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   594	    (p : PrimeSpectrum P.cover.Carrier) :
   595	    ∃ f : P.cover.Carrier, f ∉ p.asIdeal ∧
   596	      ∃ y : Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0,
   597	        (∀ q : PrimeSpectrum P.cover.Carrier, f ∉ q.asIdeal →
   598	          (y ⊗ₜ (1 : q.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
   599	            Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0 ⊗[P.cover.Carrier]
   600	              q.asIdeal.ResidueField) ≠ 0) ∧
   601	        (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app P.evaluation
   602	          ((relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) ⁻¹ᵁ
   603	            (⊤ : (Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)).Opens))).hom
   604	          (P.evaluationLiftOfH0 y) = P.pushforwardSectionOfH0 y := by
   605	  let Q := Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0
   606	  letI : Module.Finite P.cover.Carrier Q := P.h0_finite
   607	  letI : Module.Projective P.cover.Carrier Q := P.h0_projective
   608	  have hfr : Module.finrank p.asIdeal.ResidueField
   609	      (p.asIdeal.ResidueField ⊗[P.cover.Carrier] Q) = 1 := by
   610	    rw [← Module.rankAtStalk_eq]
   611	    exact P.h0_rank_one p
   612	  haveI : Nontrivial (p.asIdeal.ResidueField ⊗[P.cover.Carrier] Q) :=
   613	    Module.nontrivial_of_finrank_pos (by rw [hfr]; norm_num)
   614	  haveI : Nontrivial (Q ⊗[P.cover.Carrier] p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :=
   615	    (TensorProduct.comm P.cover.Carrier _ _).toEquiv.symm.nontrivial
   616	  obtain ⟨f, hf, y, hy⟩ :=
   617	    Module.exists_fibrewise_tmul_ne_zero_of_projective p (Q := Q)
   618	      (by infer_instance)
   619	  refine ⟨f, hf, y, ?_, ?_⟩
   620	  · simpa only [Q] using hy
   621	  · exact P.evaluation_evaluationLiftOfH0 y
   622

   624	
   625	The nonvanishing proof is derived by
   626	`sectionsMapTop_datumSectionBaseChange_away_ne_zero`; it is not additional witness data.
   627	Together with `exists_baseOpen_evaluation_generator`, this is the immediate local divisor
   628	consumer on the datum side.  Identifying it with the native evaluation zero locus remains

   630	noncomputable def baseOpenDatumSectionLocalEquations
   631	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)

   635	    (hy : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum P.cover.Carrier, f ∉ p.asIdeal →
   636	      (y ⊗ₜ (1 : p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
   637	        Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0 ⊗[P.cover.Carrier]

   668	    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L] :
   669	    (relCurve C L).Over (Spec (.of L)) :=
   670	  instOverBaseChange C L

   697	/-- The cocycle datum tied to a genus-degree presentation has class degree `genus C`
   698	after every field-valued coefficient extension.
   699	
   700	The proof follows the presentation itself: restrict `lam` to its etale-cover carrier,
   701	identify that class with `representative`, rewrite it as the datum's relative Picard class,
   702	and read the defining degree condition of `lam`. -/
   703	theorem datum_classDeg_baseChange
   704	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   705	    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L] [Algebra P.cover.Carrier L]
   706	    [IsScalarTower k P.cover.Carrier L] :
   707	    classDeg L
   708	      (Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C P.cover.Carrier L)
   709	        P.datum.cechPicClass) = genus C := by
   710	  let iota : A →ₐ[k] P.cover.Carrier :=
   711	    (Algebra.ofId A P.cover.Carrier).restrictScalars k
   712	  let psi : P.cover.Carrier →ₐ[k] L :=
   713	    (Algebra.ofId P.cover.Carrier L).restrictScalars k
   714	  have hcurve :
   715	      relCurveMap C P.cover.Carrier L =
   716	        (C ◁ Over.overSpecMap psi).left := by
   717	    refine congrArg
   718	      (fun f : overSpec k L ⟶ overSpec k P.cover.Carrier => (C ◁ f).left) ?_
   719	    exact Over.OverMorphism.ext rfl
   720	  have hpresentation :
   721	      picEtMap C (Over.overSpecMap iota) lam.1 =
   722	        relPicToPicEt C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier)
   723	          (P.representative : relPic C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier)) := by
   724	    exact picEtMap_eq_relPicToPicEt_of_affineRepresentative
   725	      C lam.1 P.cover P.representative P.represents.symm
   726	  calc
   727	    classDeg L
   728	        (Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C P.cover.Carrier L)
   729	          P.datum.cechPicClass) =
   730	      relPicDeg L
   731	        (relPicMk C (overSpec k L)
   732	          (Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C P.cover.Carrier L)
   733	            P.datum.cechPicClass)) :=
   734	      (relPicDeg_relPicMk L _).symm
   735	    _ = relPicDeg L
   736	        (relPicMap C (Over.overSpecMap psi)
   737	          (relPicMk C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier)
   738	            P.datum.cechPicClass)) := by
   739	      rw [relPicMap_mk, ← hcurve]
   740	      rfl
   741	    _ = relPicDeg L
   742	        (relPicMap C (Over.overSpecMap psi)
   743	          (P.representative : relPic C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier))) := by
   744	      rw [P.datum_class]
   745	    _ = degAt
   746	        (relPicToPicEt C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier)
   747	          (P.representative : relPic C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier)))
   748	        (Over.overSpecMap psi) :=
   749	      (degAt_relPicToPicEt
   750	        (P.representative : relPic C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier))
   751	        (Over.overSpecMap psi)).symm
   752	    _ = degAt (picEtMap C (Over.overSpecMap iota) lam.1)
   753	        (Over.overSpecMap psi) := by rw [hpresentation]
   754	    _ = degAt lam.1 (Over.overSpecMap psi ≫ Over.overSpecMap iota) :=
   755	      degAt_picEtMap (Over.overSpecMap iota) lam.1 (Over.overSpecMap psi)
   756	    _ = genus C := lam.2 L (Over.overSpecMap psi ≫ Over.overSpecMap iota)

     9	/-!
    10	# Etale-site reduction and affine PicEt honestification
    11	
    12	This file provides the site-theoretic and affine-plus infrastructure used to turn affine
    13	local lifts into local surjectivity on the big etale site. It also packages the passage from
    14	an affine `picEt` class to an honest relative Picard class after restriction to the carrier of
    15	one of its etale presentations.
    16	
    17	The declarations here are independent of the Abel transformation and make no representability
    18	or quotient assertion.
    19	-/
    20	
    21	set_option autoImplicit false
    22

    24	
    25	open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite
    26	
    27	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    28

    30	
    31	/-! ## Reduction to affine tests -/
    32	
    33	/-- A sieve on a scheme is etale-covering if its pullback to every member of the canonical
    34	affine open cover is etale-covering. -/
    35	theorem mem_etaleTopology_of_pullback_affine {T : Scheme.{u}} (S : Sieve T)
    36	    (h : ∀ (j : T.affineCover.I₀), S.pullback (T.affineCover.f j) ∈
    37	      Scheme.etaleTopology (T.affineCover.X j)) :
    38	    S ∈ Scheme.etaleTopology T := by
    39	  have hcov : (Sieve.generate (Presieve.ofArrows T.affineCover.X T.affineCover.f))
    40	      ∈ Scheme.etaleTopology T := by
    41	    apply Scheme.zariskiTopology_le_etaleTopology
    42	    exact Scheme.mem_grothendieckTopology_iff.mpr
    43	      ⟨T.affineCover, Sieve.le_generate _⟩
    44	  refine Scheme.etaleTopology.transitive hcov S ?_
    45	  rintro Y g ⟨V, a, b, ⟨j⟩, rfl⟩
    46	  rw [Sieve.pullback_comp]
    47	  exact Scheme.etaleTopology.pullback_stable a (h j)
    48	
    49	/-- To prove local surjectivity on the big etale site, it suffices to produce an etale cover
    50	with local lifts over every affine test scheme. -/
    51	theorem isLocallySurjective_etale_of_affine
    52	    {F G : Scheme.{u}ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u} (f : F ⟶ G)
    53	    (h : ∀ (Y : Scheme.{u}) [IsAffine Y] (s : G.obj (op Y)),
    54	      ∃ (cover : Y.Cover.{u} (Scheme.precoverage @Etale)),
    55	        ∀ j : cover.I₀, ∃ x : F.obj (op (cover.X j)),
    56	          f.app (op (cover.X j)) x = G.map (cover.f j).op s) :
    57	    Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective Scheme.etaleTopology f where
    58	  imageSieve_mem {U} s := by
    59	    apply mem_etaleTopology_of_pullback_affine
    60	    intro j
    61	    rw [Presheaf.pullback_imageSieve]
    62	    obtain ⟨cover, hcover⟩ :=
    63	      h (U.affineCover.X j) (G.map (U.affineCover.f j).op s)
    64	    refine (Scheme.mem_grothendieckTopology_iff (P := @Etale)).mpr ⟨cover, ?_⟩
    65	    rintro Y g ⟨i⟩
    66	    exact hcover i
    67	
    68	/-! ## Covers induced by affine etale presentations -/
    69	
    70	/-- The spectrum of the carrier of an algebraic etale cover is a singleton etale cover of
    71	the spectrum of the base algebra. -/
    72	noncomputable def etaleSchemeCover {A : Type u} [CommRing A]
    73	    (E : Algebra.EtaleCover A) :
    74	    (Spec (.of A)).Cover (Scheme.precoverage @Etale) :=
    75	  Scheme.Cover.mkOfCovers PUnit (fun _ => Spec (.of E.Carrier))
    76	    (fun _ => Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A E.Carrier)))
    77	    (fun x => by
    78	      obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := E.comap_surjective x
    79	      exact ⟨PUnit.unit, y, hy⟩)
    80	    (fun _ => by
    81	      rw [HasRingHomProperty.Spec_iff (P := @Etale)]
    82	      exact RingHom.etale_algebraMap.mpr inferInstance)
    83	
    84	/-! ## Honestification of affine PicEt classes -/
    85	
    86	namespace PicEtAff
    87	
    88	/-- `mapAlg` agrees with the instance-based affine restriction map when the underlying ring
    89	homomorphism is the chosen `A`-algebra structure on `B`. -/
    90	theorem mapAlg_eq_map_of_toRingHom_eq_algebraMap
    91	    {k A B : Type u} [Field k] [CommRing A] [Algebra k A] [CommRing B]
    92	    [Algebra k B] [Algebra A B] [IsScalarTower k A B]
    93	    (C : Over (Spec (.of k))) (phi : A →ₐ[k] B)
    94	    (hphi : phi.toRingHom = algebraMap A B) (a : PicEtAff C A) :
    95	    PicEtAff.mapAlg C phi a = PicEtAff.map C B a := by
    96	  have hAlg : phi.toRingHom.toAlgebra = (inferInstance : Algebra A B) :=
    97	    Algebra.algebra_ext _ _ fun r => by
    98	      change phi r = algebraMap A B r
    99	      exact DFunLike.congr_fun hphi r
   100	  unfold PicEtAff.mapAlg
   101	  subst hAlg
   102	  rfl
   103	
   104	/-- Restricting an affine PicEt presentation along the map to its own cover carrier produces
   105	the honest class represented by its descent datum. -/
   106	theorem mapAlg_mk_eq_unit_self
   107	    {k A : Type u} [Field k] [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
   108	    (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
   109	    (E : Algebra.EtaleCover A) (x : descentClasses C E) :
   110	    PicEtAff.mapAlg C ((Algebra.ofId A E.Carrier).restrictScalars k)
   111	        (PicEtAff.mk C E x)
   112	      = PicEtAff.unit C E.Carrier
   113	          (x : relPic C (overSpec k E.Carrier)) := by
   114	  rw [mapAlg_eq_map_of_toRingHom_eq_algebraMap C _ rfl]
   115	  exact PicEtAff.map_mk_eq_unit_self C E x
   116	
   117	end PicEtAff
   118	
   119	/-- On affine tests, restricting a `picEt` class to the carrier of one of its plus
   120	presentations agrees with the `picEt` unit of the corresponding honest relative Picard
   121	class. -/
   122	theorem picEtMap_eq_relPicToPicEt_of_affineRepresentative
   123	    {k A : Type u} [Field k] [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
   124	    (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
   125	    [IsProper C.hom] [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] [GeometricallyReduced C.hom]
   126	    (lam : picEt C (overSpec k A)) (E : Algebra.EtaleCover A)
   127	    (x : descentClasses C E)
   128	    (h : picEtAffineEquiv C A lam = PicEtAff.mk C E x) :
   129	    picEtMap C
   130	        (Over.overSpecMap ((Algebra.ofId A E.Carrier).restrictScalars k)) lam
   131	      = relPicToPicEt C (overSpec k E.Carrier)
   132	          (x : relPic C (overSpec k E.Carrier)) := by
   133	  apply (picEtAffineEquiv C E.Carrier).injective
   134	  rw [picEtAffineEquiv_naturality, h,
   135	    picEtAffineEquiv_relPicToPicEt,
   136	    PicEtAff.mapAlg_mk_eq_unit_self]
   137	
   138	end
   139	
   140	end AlgebraicGeometry

    85	    ↥(gluedSubmodule B' (D.baseChange B').pieces (D.baseChange B').unit ⊤) :=
    86	  D.sectionsMap B' (by rw [Scheme.Hom.preimage_top]) s

    88	/-- Components of the compared global section are the compared original components. -/
    89	theorem component_sectionsMapTop (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B pi)
    90	    (s : ↥(gluedSubmodule B D.pieces D.unit ⊤)) (j : D.index) :
    91	    (D.baseChange B').component (D.sectionsMapTop B' s) j =
    92	      D.toBasicOpenCoverData.piecesMap B' j (D.component s j) := by
    93	  let htop : (⊤ : (relCurve C B').Opens) ≤
    94	      relCurveMap C B B' ⁻¹ᵁ (⊤ : (relCurve C B).Opens) := by
    95	    rw [Scheme.Hom.preimage_top]
    96	  cases j with
    97	  | inl j =>
    98	      simpa only [sectionsMapTop, component, sectionsMap_coe,
    99	        BasicOpenCocycleDatum.baseChange, BasicOpenCoverData.piecesMap,
   100	        BasicOpenCoverData.pieces, BasicOpenCoverData.baseChange,
   101	        Sum.elim_inl, pieceSectionsMap] using
   102	        (relCurveMap C B B').appLE_resHom
   103	          (le_inf le_top le_rfl : D.pieces (Sum.inl j) ≤ ⊤ ⊓ D.pieces (Sum.inl j))
   104	          (D.sectionsMap_component_le B' htop (Sum.inl j))
   105	          (D.toBasicOpenCoverData.baseChange_pieces_le_preimage B' (Sum.inl j))
   106	          (le_inf le_top le_rfl : (D.baseChange B').pieces (Sum.inl j) ≤
   107	            ⊤ ⊓ (D.baseChange B').pieces (Sum.inl j)) (s.val (Sum.inl j))
   108	  | inr j =>
   109	      simpa only [sectionsMapTop, component, sectionsMap_coe,
   110	        BasicOpenCocycleDatum.baseChange, BasicOpenCoverData.piecesMap,
   111	        BasicOpenCoverData.pieces, BasicOpenCoverData.baseChange,
   112	        Sum.elim_inr, pieceSectionsMap] using
   113	        (relCurveMap C B B').appLE_resHom
   114	          (le_inf le_top le_rfl : D.pieces (Sum.inr j) ≤ ⊤ ⊓ D.pieces (Sum.inr j))
   115	          (D.sectionsMap_component_le B' htop (Sum.inr j))
   116	          (D.toBasicOpenCoverData.baseChange_pieces_le_preimage B' (Sum.inr j))
   117	          (le_inf le_top le_rfl : (D.baseChange B').pieces (Sum.inr j) ≤
   118	            ⊤ ⊓ (D.baseChange B').pieces (Sum.inr j)) (s.val (Sum.inr j))

   120	variable {K : Type u} [Field K] [Algebra k K]
   121	
   122	set_option synthInstance.maxHeartbeats 800000 in
   123	-- The glued trivialization carries a large dependent family of section rings.
   124	-- A nonzero global section of a cocycle-glued line bundle on an integral scheme is
   125	-- nonzero in every nonempty trivializing piece.
   126	theorem component_ne_zero_of_global_ne_zero
   127	    [IsIntegral (relCurve C K)] (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C K pi)
   128	    (s : ↥(gluedSubmodule K D.pieces D.unit ⊤)) (hs : s ≠ 0)
   129	    (j : D.index) (hj : D.pieces j ≠ ⊥) : D.component s j ≠ 0 := by
   130	  intro hcomponent
   131	  apply hs
   132	  have hUj : ((D.pieces j : Set (relCurve C K))).Nonempty := by
   133	    rcases Set.eq_empty_or_nonempty (D.pieces j : Set (relCurve C K)) with h | h
   134	    · exact (hj (by ext x; rw [h]; simp)).elim
   135	    · exact h
   136	  have hres : gluedRes K D.pieces D.unit (le_top : D.pieces j ≤ ⊤) s = 0 := by
   137	    apply (gluedTriv K D.isGluingCocycle j le_rfl).injective
   138	    rw [map_zero, gluedTriv_apply, gluedRes_coe]
   139	    simpa only [component, Scheme.resHom_resHom] using hcomponent
   140	  apply Subtype.ext
   141	  funext i
   142	  by_cases hi : D.pieces i = ⊥
   143	  · have hopen : ⊤ ⊓ D.pieces i = ⊥ := by rw [hi]; simp
   144	    letI : Subsingleton Γ(relCurve C K, ⊤ ⊓ D.pieces i) := hopen ▸ inferInstance
   145	    exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
   146	  · have hUi : ((D.pieces i : Set (relCurve C K))).Nonempty := by
   147	      rcases Set.eq_empty_or_nonempty (D.pieces i : Set (relCurve C K)) with h | h
   148	      · exact (hi (by ext x; rw [h]; simp)).elim
   149	      · exact h
   150	    have hUji : (((D.pieces j ⊓ D.pieces i : (relCurve C K).Opens) :
   151	        Set (relCurve C K))).Nonempty := by
   152	      simpa only [Opens.coe_inf] using
   153	        nonempty_preirreducible_inter (D.pieces j).isOpen (D.pieces i).isOpen hUj hUi
   154	    letI : Nonempty ↥((D.pieces j ⊓ D.pieces i : (relCurve C K).Opens) :
   155	        Set (relCurve C K)) := by
   156	      obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hUji
   157	      exact ⟨⟨x, hx⟩⟩
   158	    have hinj : Function.Injective ((relCurve C K).resHom
   159	        (show D.pieces j ⊓ D.pieces i ≤ ⊤ ⊓ D.pieces i by simp)) :=
   160	      map_injective_of_isIntegral (H := this) (relCurve C K)
   161	        (homOfLE (show D.pieces j ⊓ D.pieces i ≤ ⊤ ⊓ D.pieces i by simp))
   162	    apply hinj
   163	    have hval := congrArg (fun t => t.val i) hres
   164	    simpa only [gluedRes_coe, Pi.zero_apply, Submodule.coe_zero, map_zero] using hval
   165	
   166	/-- Every component of a nonzero global cocycle-glued section on an integral scheme is
   167	a nonzerodivisor, including the vacuous empty-piece case. -/
   168	theorem component_mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_global_ne_zero
   169	    [IsIntegral (relCurve C K)] (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C K pi)
   170	    (s : ↥(gluedSubmodule K D.pieces D.unit ⊤)) (hs : s ≠ 0) (j : D.index) :
   171	    D.component s j ∈ nonZeroDivisors Γ(relCurve C K, D.pieces j) := by
   172	  by_cases hj : D.pieces j = ⊥
   173	  · letI : Subsingleton Γ(relCurve C K, D.pieces j) := hj ▸ inferInstance
   174	    rw [mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_right]
   175	    intro z _
   176	    exact Subsingleton.elim z 0
   177	  · have hUj : ((D.pieces j : Set (relCurve C K))).Nonempty := by
   178	      rcases Set.eq_empty_or_nonempty (D.pieces j : Set (relCurve C K)) with h | h
   179	      · exact (hj (by ext x; rw [h]; simp)).elim
   180	      · exact h
   181	    let hnonempty : Nonempty {x : relCurve C K // x ∈ D.pieces j} := by
   182	      obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hUj
   183	      exact ⟨⟨x, hx⟩⟩
   184	    haveI : IsDomain Γ(relCurve C K, D.pieces j) :=
   185	      @IsIntegral.component_integral (relCurve C K) _ (D.pieces j) hnonempty
   186	    exact mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_ne_zero
   187	      (D.component_ne_zero_of_global_ne_zero s hs j hj)

   189	variable {B : Type u} [CommRing B] [Algebra k B]

   191	set_option maxHeartbeats 800000 in
   192	-- Elaborating the tensor swap and piecewise base-change equivalence needs extra heartbeats.
   193	theorem injective_rTensor_component_of_sectionsMapTop_ne_zero
   194	    (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B pi)
   195	    (s : ↥(gluedSubmodule B D.pieces D.unit ⊤)) (p : PrimeSpectrum B)
   196	    [IsIntegral (relCurve C p.asIdeal.ResidueField)]
   197	    (hs : D.sectionsMapTop p.asIdeal.ResidueField s ≠ 0) (j : D.index) :
   198	    Function.Injective
   199	      ((Scheme.mulSectionEnd B (D.component s j)).rTensor p.asIdeal.ResidueField) := by
   200	  let e : Γ(relCurve C B, D.pieces j) ⊗[B] p.asIdeal.ResidueField ≃+*
   201	      Γ(relCurve C p.asIdeal.ResidueField,
   202	        (D.baseChange p.asIdeal.ResidueField).pieces j) :=
   203	    (Algebra.TensorProduct.comm B Γ(relCurve C B, D.pieces j)
   204	      p.asIdeal.ResidueField).toRingEquiv.trans
   205	        (D.toBasicOpenCoverData.pieceTermBaseChange p.asIdeal.ResidueField j).toRingEquiv
   206	  have hvalue : e (D.component s j ⊗ₜ[B] (1 : p.asIdeal.ResidueField)) =
   207	      (D.baseChange p.asIdeal.ResidueField).component
   208	        (D.sectionsMapTop p.asIdeal.ResidueField s) j := by
   209	    change D.toBasicOpenCoverData.pieceTermBaseChange p.asIdeal.ResidueField j
   210	      (Algebra.TensorProduct.comm B Γ(relCurve C B, D.pieces j)
   211	        p.asIdeal.ResidueField
   212	          (D.component s j ⊗ₜ[B] (1 : p.asIdeal.ResidueField))) = _
   213	    rw [Algebra.TensorProduct.comm_tmul,
   214	      D.toBasicOpenCoverData.pieceTermBaseChange_one_tmul
   215	        p.asIdeal.ResidueField j (D.component s j),
   216	      ← D.component_sectionsMapTop p.asIdeal.ResidueField s j]
   217	  have hregular : (D.baseChange p.asIdeal.ResidueField).component
   218	        (D.sectionsMapTop p.asIdeal.ResidueField s) j ∈
   219	      nonZeroDivisors Γ(relCurve C p.asIdeal.ResidueField,
   220	        (D.baseChange p.asIdeal.ResidueField).pieces j) :=
   221	    (D.baseChange p.asIdeal.ResidueField).component_mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_global_ne_zero
   222	      (D.sectionsMapTop p.asIdeal.ResidueField s) hs j
   223	  have himage : e (D.component s j ⊗ₜ[B] (1 : p.asIdeal.ResidueField)) ∈
   224	      nonZeroDivisors Γ(relCurve C p.asIdeal.ResidueField,
   225	        (D.baseChange p.asIdeal.ResidueField).pieces j) := by
   226	    rwa [hvalue]
   227	  have hback : e.symm (e (D.component s j ⊗ₜ[B]
   228	      (1 : p.asIdeal.ResidueField))) ∈
   229	      nonZeroDivisors (Γ(relCurve C B, D.pieces j) ⊗[B] p.asIdeal.ResidueField) := by
   230	    rw [← MulEquivClass.map_nonZeroDivisors e.symm]
   231	    exact ⟨_, himage, rfl⟩
   232	  apply injective_rTensor_mulSectionEnd_of_tmul_mem_nonZeroDivisors B
   233	    (D.component s j) p
   234	  simpa only [e.symm_apply_apply] using hback
   235

    11	/-!
    12	# The consumed local divisor package for the rank-one route
    13	
    14	This module is the first divisor consumer of PicRankOneLocalPresentation.  The projective
    15	rank-one H0 module supplies a basic open and a section which is nonzero on every residue fibre
    16	there.  The datum-side section construction then gives regular local equations, and the widened
    17	effectivity engine packages those equations as a DivFamZarAff of degree genus C.
    18	
    19	The package is deliberately local and presentation-tied.  It does not define the canonical
    20	family-level divisorOfRankOne, identify the equations with the native zero locus, or assert
    21	that the rank-one locus is represented by an open subscheme.  Those remain the next contracts.
    22	-/

    80	/-- The local equations cut from the tied datum section remain regular after every field-valued
    81	coefficient extension.  This is the regularity input consumed by the widened effectivity
    82	engine, derived from the same fibrewise nonvanishing hypothesis used in the construction. -/
    83	theorem baseOpenDatumSectionLocalEquations_fibrewiseRegular
    84	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
    85	    [IsNoetherianRing P.cover.Carrier]
    86	    (f : P.cover.Carrier)
    87	    (y : Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0)
    88	    (hy : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum P.cover.Carrier, f ∉ p.asIdeal →
    89	      (y ⊗ₜ (1 : p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
    90	        Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0 ⊗[P.cover.Carrier]
    91	          p.asIdeal.ResidueField) ≠ 0)
    92	    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L]
    93	    [Algebra (Localization.Away f) L]
    94	    [IsScalarTower k (Localization.Away f) L]
    95	    (z : relCurve C L) :
    96	    ((relCurve C L).presheaf.germ
    97	      (((P.baseOpenDatumSectionLocalEquations f y hy).cover.pullback
    98	        (relCurveMap C (Localization.Away f) L)).opens z) z
    99	      (((P.baseOpenDatumSectionLocalEquations f y hy).cover.pullback
   100	        (relCurveMap C (Localization.Away f) L)).mem_opens z)).hom
   101	      (Scheme.LocalEquations.pullbackEqn
   102	        (relCurveMap C (Localization.Away f) L)
   103	        (P.baseOpenDatumSectionLocalEquations f y hy) z) ∈

   115	    fun j q => D.injective_rTensor_component_of_sectionsMapTop_ne_zero
   116	      s q (hsec q) j

   118	  exact D.germ_self_pullbackEqn_sectionLocalEquationsOfFibrewiseRegular

   225	/-- The Abel value of the local divisor is the restriction of the input Picard datum.  This is
   226	the immediate consumer which keeps the widened divisor tied to the chosen presentation. -/
   227	theorem baseOpenRankOneDivisor_abelAff
   228	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   229	    [IsNoetherianRing P.cover.Carrier]
   230	    (f : P.cover.Carrier)
   231	    (y : Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0)
   232	    (hy : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum P.cover.Carrier, f ∉ p.asIdeal →
   233	      (y ⊗ₜ (1 : p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
   234	        Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0 ⊗[P.cover.Carrier]
   235	          p.asIdeal.ResidueField) ≠ 0) :
   236	    abelDivAffPlus C (Localization.Away f) (P.baseOpenRankOneDivisor f y hy) =
   237	      PicEtAff.mapAlg C ((Algebra.ofId P.cover.Carrier (Localization.Away f)).restrictScalars k)
   238	        (PicEtAff.mapAlg C ((Algebra.ofId A P.cover.Carrier).restrictScalars k)
   239	          (picEtAffineEquiv C A lam.1)) := by
   240	  let B := Localization.Away f
   241	  let iota : A →ₐ[k] P.cover.Carrier :=
   242	    (Algebra.ofId A P.cover.Carrier).restrictScalars k
   243	  let psi : P.cover.Carrier →ₐ[k] B :=
   244	    (Algebra.ofId P.cover.Carrier B).restrictScalars k
   245	  let F := P.baseOpenRankOneDivisor f y hy
   246	  have hFclass : F.picClass = (P.datum.baseChange B).cechPicClass :=
   247	    P.baseOpenRankOneDivisor_picClass f y hy
   248	  have hrel : (relPicMk C (overSpec k B)) F.picClass =
   249	      relPicAlgMap C psi (P.representative : relPic C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier)) := by
   250	    rw [hFclass, P.datum_class, relPicAlgMap_mk]
   251	    have hcurve : Over.Hom.left (C ◁ Over.overSpecMap psi) =
   252	        relCurveMap C P.cover.Carrier B := by
   253	      refine congrArg (fun f : overSpec k B ⟶ overSpec k P.cover.Carrier => (C ◁ f).left) ?_
   254	      exact Over.OverMorphism.ext rfl
   255	    rw [P.datum.cechPicClass_baseChange B, hcurve]
   256	    rfl
   257	  calc
   258	    abelDivAffPlus C B F = PicEtAff.unit C B ((relPicMk C (overSpec k B)) F.picClass) := rfl
   259	    _ = PicEtAff.unit C B (relPicAlgMap C psi
   260	      (P.representative : relPic C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier))) := by rw [hrel]
   261	    _ = PicEtAff.mapAlg C psi
   262	      (PicEtAff.unit C P.cover.Carrier
   263	        (P.representative : relPic C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier))) := by
   264	      rw [PicEtAff.mapAlg_unit]
   265	    _ = PicEtAff.mapAlg C psi (PicEtAff.mapAlg C iota (picEtAffineEquiv C A lam.1)) := by
   266	      congr 1
   267	      rw [← P.represents, PicEtAff.mapAlg_mk_eq_unit_self]

   269	/-- Every base point of a rank-one presentation has a tied local widened divisor.  The final

   272	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   273	    [IsNoetherianRing P.cover.Carrier]
   274	    (p : PrimeSpectrum P.cover.Carrier) :
   275	    ∃ f : P.cover.Carrier, f ∉ p.asIdeal ∧
   276	      ∃ (y : Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0)

   278	          (y ⊗ₜ (1 : q.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
   279	            Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0 ⊗[P.cover.Carrier]
   280	              q.asIdeal.ResidueField) ≠ 0),

   284	            ((relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) ⁻¹ᵁ
   285	              (⊤ : (Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)).Opens))).hom
   286	            (P.evaluationLiftOfH0 y) = P.pushforwardSectionOfH0 y := by
   287	  obtain ⟨f, hf, y, hy, heval⟩ := P.exists_baseOpen_evaluation_generator p
   288	  exact ⟨f, hf, y, hy, P.baseOpenRankOneDivisor_picClass f y hy, heval⟩

   697	/-- The cocycle datum tied to a genus-degree presentation has class degree `genus C`
   698	after every field-valued coefficient extension.
   699	
   700	The proof follows the presentation itself: restrict `lam` to its etale-cover carrier,
   701	identify that class with `representative`, rewrite it as the datum's relative Picard class,
   702	and read the defining degree condition of `lam`. -/
   703	theorem datum_classDeg_baseChange
   704	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   705	    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L] [Algebra P.cover.Carrier L]
   706	    [IsScalarTower k P.cover.Carrier L] :
   707	    classDeg L
   708	      (Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C P.cover.Carrier L)
   709	        P.datum.cechPicClass) = genus C := by
   710	  let iota : A →ₐ[k] P.cover.Carrier :=
   711	    (Algebra.ofId A P.cover.Carrier).restrictScalars k
   712	  let psi : P.cover.Carrier →ₐ[k] L :=
   713	    (Algebra.ofId P.cover.Carrier L).restrictScalars k
   714	  have hcurve :
   715	      relCurveMap C P.cover.Carrier L =
   716	        (C ◁ Over.overSpecMap psi).left := by
   717	    refine congrArg
   718	      (fun f : overSpec k L ⟶ overSpec k P.cover.Carrier => (C ◁ f).left) ?_
   719	    exact Over.OverMorphism.ext rfl
   720	  have hpresentation :
   721	      picEtMap C (Over.overSpecMap iota) lam.1 =
   722	        relPicToPicEt C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier)
   723	          (P.representative : relPic C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier)) := by
   724	    exact picEtMap_eq_relPicToPicEt_of_affineRepresentative
   725	      C lam.1 P.cover P.representative P.represents.symm
   726	  calc
   727	    classDeg L
   728	        (Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C P.cover.Carrier L)
   729	          P.datum.cechPicClass) =
   730	      relPicDeg L
   731	        (relPicMk C (overSpec k L)
   732	          (Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C P.cover.Carrier L)
   733	            P.datum.cechPicClass)) :=
   734	      (relPicDeg_relPicMk L _).symm
   735	    _ = relPicDeg L
   736	        (relPicMap C (Over.overSpecMap psi)
   737	          (relPicMk C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier)
   738	            P.datum.cechPicClass)) := by
   739	      rw [relPicMap_mk, ← hcurve]
   740	      rfl
   741	    _ = relPicDeg L
   742	        (relPicMap C (Over.overSpecMap psi)
   743	          (P.representative : relPic C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier))) := by
   744	      rw [P.datum_class]
   745	    _ = degAt
   746	        (relPicToPicEt C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier)
   747	          (P.representative : relPic C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier)))
   748	        (Over.overSpecMap psi) :=
   749	      (degAt_relPicToPicEt
   750	        (P.representative : relPic C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier))
   751	        (Over.overSpecMap psi)).symm
   752	    _ = degAt (picEtMap C (Over.overSpecMap iota) lam.1)
   753	        (Over.overSpecMap psi) := by rw [hpresentation]
   754	    _ = degAt lam.1 (Over.overSpecMap psi ≫ Over.overSpecMap iota) :=
   755	      degAt_picEtMap (Over.overSpecMap iota) lam.1 (Over.overSpecMap psi)
   756	    _ = genus C := lam.2 L (Over.overSpecMap psi ≫ Over.overSpecMap iota)

    15	the class `[𝒪(d)]` itself, together with its canonical section. This file pins both:
    16	
    17	* `AlgebraicGeometry.BasicOpenCocycleDatum.inv` — the **datum inverse**: same cover
    18	  data, transition units `(g i j)⁻¹`; the cocycle law inverts termwise.
    19	* `BasicOpenCocycleDatum.cechPicClass_inv` — the class law
    20	  `D.inv.cechPicClass = D.cechPicClass⁻¹` (subordinated-cocycle level).
    21	* `AlgebraicGeometry.relThetaCocycle_zero`, `FinCoverData.thetaOvlUnit_zero`,
    22	  `thetaChartUnit_zero`, `cechPicClass_thetaChartDatum_zero` — at exponent `a = 0`
    23	  the theta twisting cocycle is trivial, so the whole-chart theta datum has class `1`
    24	  **over an arbitrary test ring** (the worksheet cites the base-`k` class law
    25	  `cechPicClass_thetaChartDatum` + `fiberTwist_zero`; the direct `a = 0` computation
    26	  is ring-generic, which the §2 consumers need — recorded deviation).
    27	* `DivisorAdaptation.divisorDatum` — **the divisor datum**
    28	  `(A.thetaIdealDatum 0).inv`, with class law
    29	  `cechPicClass_divisorDatum : A.divisorDatum.cechPicClass = d.picClass`
    30	  (G-0a at `a = 0` + the trivial theta block + `cechPicClass_inv`).
    31	* `DivisorAdaptation.canonSection` — **the canonical section is the equation system
    32	  itself** (N2): the components `(A.eqn j)` satisfy the inverse-datum matching
    33	  condition (`eqn_mul_eqnRatio` read against the inverted units), giving a global
    34	  section of the divisor datum's glued sheaf.
    35	* `DivisorAdaptation.divEq_sectionLocalEquations_canonSection` — **(N2) cut-back by
    36	  pure refinement**: the `LocalEquations` datum cut by `canonSection` (DAT-A
    37	  `sectionLocalEquations`, on any subordinated pointed cover) is `DivEq` to `d` —
    38	  the comparison units are the adaptation's own `eqn_rel` units; no fibre argument.
    39	-/

    63	/-- The pair value of an inverse unit cocycle is the inverse pair value. -/
    64	private lemma inv_unitsEvInf {X : Scheme.{u}} {𝒰 : X.PointedCover}
    65	    (γ : X.unitsCocycle 𝒰) (i j : X) :
    66	    Scheme.unitsEvInf γ⁻¹ i j = (Scheme.unitsEvInf γ i j)⁻¹ := rfl

    68	/-- The unit-level cocycle identity of a datum (the value-level law `mul_res`
    69	re-packaged through `Units.ext`). -/
    70	private lemma unitsRestrict_unit_mul (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B π)
    71	    (i j l : D.index) :
    72	    (relCurve C B).unitsRestrict
    73	        (inf_le_left : D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j ⊓ D.pieces l ≤ D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j)
    74	        (D.unit i j)
    75	      * (relCurve C B).unitsRestrict (gluedInclCoc D.pieces (D.pieces i) j l)
    76	          (D.unit j l)
    77	      = (relCurve C B).unitsRestrict (gluedInclSnd D.pieces (D.pieces i) j l)
    78	          (D.unit i l) :=
    79	  Units.ext (D.isGluingCocycle.mul_res i j l)
    80	
    81	/-- **The datum inverse** (worksheet GAP-1): the same basic-open cover data with the
    82	termwise-inverted transition units `(g i j)⁻¹`. The cocycle law inverts termwise —
    83	the units are honest `Units`, and the section rings are commutative. -/
    84	noncomputable def inv (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B π) :
    85	    BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B π where
    86	  toBasicOpenCoverData := D.toBasicOpenCoverData
    87	  unit i j := (D.unit i j)⁻¹
    88	  isGluingCocycle := by
    89	    constructor
    90	    · intro i
    91	      rw [show D.unit i i = 1 from Units.ext (D.isGluingCocycle.unit_self i), inv_one,
    92	        Units.val_one]
    93	    · intro i j l
    94	      have key : ((relCurve C B).unitsRestrict
    95	            (inf_le_left :
    96	              D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j ⊓ D.pieces l ≤ D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j)
    97	            (D.unit i j))⁻¹
    98	          * ((relCurve C B).unitsRestrict (gluedInclCoc D.pieces (D.pieces i) j l)
    99	              (D.unit j l))⁻¹
   100	          = ((relCurve C B).unitsRestrict (gluedInclSnd D.pieces (D.pieces i) j l)
   101	              (D.unit i l))⁻¹ := by
   102	        rw [← mul_inv]
   103	        exact congrArg (·⁻¹) (D.unitsRestrict_unit_mul i j l)
   104	      have hval := congrArg Units.val key
   105	      rw [Units.val_mul] at hval
   106	      exact hval
   107	
   108	@[simp]
   109	lemma inv_pieces (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B π) : D.inv.pieces = D.pieces := rfl
   110	
   111	@[simp]
   112	lemma inv_unit (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B π) (i j : D.index) :
   113	    D.inv.unit i j = (D.unit i j)⁻¹ := rfl
   114	
   115	/-- **The class law of the datum inverse**: `[D⁻¹] = [D]⁻¹`. Both classes are computed
   116	by subordinated cocycles on `D`'s canonical pointed cover by pieces, where the
   117	subordinated cocycle of the inverse datum is the inverse cocycle. -/
   118	theorem cechPicClass_inv (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B π) :
   119	    D.inv.cechPicClass = D.cechPicClass⁻¹ := by
   120	  have hσ : ∀ x : relCurve C B,
   121	      D.pointedCover.opens x ≤ D.inv.pieces (D.pieceIndex x) :=
   122	    fun _ => le_rfl
   123	  have hco : gluedSubordCocycle D.inv.isGluingCocycle D.pointedCover D.pieceIndex hσ
   124	      = (gluedSubordCocycle D.isGluingCocycle D.pointedCover D.pieceIndex
   125	          (fun _ => le_rfl))⁻¹ := by
   126	    refine Scheme.unitsCocycle_ext fun x y => ?_
   127	    rw [gluedSubordCocycle_evInf, inv_unitsEvInf, gluedSubordCocycle_evInf]
   128	    exact Units.ext rfl
   129	  calc D.inv.cechPicClass
   130	      = Scheme.CechPic.mk D.pointedCover
   131	          (gluedSubordCocycle D.inv.isGluingCocycle D.pointedCover D.pieceIndex
   132	            hσ).class :=
   133	        (D.inv.cechPicClass_eq_mk D.pointedCover D.pieceIndex hσ).symm
   134	    _ = Scheme.CechPic.mk D.pointedCover
   135	          ((gluedSubordCocycle D.isGluingCocycle D.pointedCover D.pieceIndex
   136	            (fun _ => le_rfl)).class)⁻¹ := by
   137	        rw [hco, OneCocycle.class_inv]
   138	    _ = D.cechPicClass⁻¹ := rfl

   154	/-- The theta twisting units of a finite cover datum are trivial at exponent `0`. -/
   155	theorem FinCoverData.thetaOvlUnit_zero (D : FinCoverData C B π) (i j : D.index) :
   156	    D.thetaOvlUnit 0 i j = 1 := by
   157	  rcases i with i | i <;> rcases j with j | j
   158	  · rfl
   159	  · rw [FinCoverData.thetaOvlUnit_inl_inr, relThetaCocycle_zero, map_one]
   160	  · rw [FinCoverData.thetaOvlUnit_inr_inl, relThetaCocycle_zero, map_one, inv_one]

   167	  · rfl
   168	  · change (relCurve C B).unitsRestrict _ (relThetaCocycle C B π 0) = 1
   169	    rw [relThetaCocycle_zero, map_one]
   170	  · change (relCurve C B).unitsRestrict _ (relThetaCocycle C B π 0)⁻¹ = 1
   171	    rw [relThetaCocycle_zero, inv_one, map_one]
   172	  · rfl

180	  have hco : gluedSubordCocycle (thetaChartDatum C B π 0).isGluingCocycle
   181	      (thetaChartDatum C B π 0).pointedCover (thetaChartDatum C B π 0).pieceIndex
   182	      (fun _ => le_rfl) = 1 := by

   185	    change (relCurve C B).unitsRestrict _

   191	        (thetaChartDatum C B π 0).pointedCover (thetaChartDatum C B π 0).pieceIndex

   197	/-! ## The divisor datum and its class law -/
   198	
   199	namespace DivisorAdaptation
   200	
   201	variable {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [Algebra k R]
   202	variable {π : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsFinite π]
   203	variable {d : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations} (A : DivisorAdaptation C R π d)
   204	
   205	/-- The ideal transition units at exponent `0` are the plain ratio units `f_j/f_i`:
   206	the theta block is trivial. -/
   207	theorem thetaIdealUnit_zero (i j : A.index) :
   208	    A.thetaIdealUnit 0 i j = A.eqnRatio i j := by
   209	  rw [thetaIdealUnit, A.toFinCoverData.thetaOvlUnit_zero, mul_one]
   210	
   211	/-- **The divisor datum of an adaptation** (worksheet GAP-1): the inverse of the
   212	twisted ideal datum at exponent `0` — a pinned cocycle datum in the class `[𝒪(d)]`
   213	(`cechPicClass_divisorDatum`), whose transition units are the inverted ratio units
   214	`(f_j/f_i)⁻¹`. -/
   215	noncomputable def divisorDatum : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C R π :=
   216	  (A.thetaIdealDatum 0).inv
   217	
   218	/-- **The class law of the divisor datum**: `[divisorDatum] = [𝒪(d)]` — G-0a at
   219	`a = 0`, the trivial theta block, and the class law of the datum inverse. -/
   220	theorem cechPicClass_divisorDatum : A.divisorDatum.cechPicClass = d.picClass := by
   221	  change (A.thetaIdealDatum 0).inv.cechPicClass = d.picClass
   222	  rw [BasicOpenCocycleDatum.cechPicClass_inv, A.cechPicClass_thetaIdealDatum 0,
   223	    cechPicClass_thetaChartDatum_zero, one_mul, inv_inv]
   224	
   225	/-! ### The canonical section -/
   226	
   227	/-- The value-level matching law of the equation components against the inverted ratio
   228	units: `f_i = (f_j/f_i)⁻¹ · f_j` on any open below the piece overlap. -/
   229	private lemma res_eqn_eq_inv_eqnRatio_mul (i j : A.index) {O : (relCurve C R).Opens}
   230	    (hO : O ≤ A.pieces i ⊓ A.pieces j) :
   231	    (relCurve C R).resHom (hO.trans inf_le_left) (A.eqn i)
   232	      = (relCurve C R).resHom hO
   233	          (((A.eqnRatio i j)⁻¹ : Γ(relCurve C R, A.pieces i ⊓ A.pieces j)ˣ) :
   234	            Γ(relCurve C R, A.pieces i ⊓ A.pieces j))
   235	        * (relCurve C R).resHom (hO.trans inf_le_right) (A.eqn j) := by
   236	  have key := congrArg ((relCurve C R).resHom hO) (A.eqn_mul_eqnRatio i j)
   237	  rw [map_mul] at key
   238	  simp only [Scheme.resHom_resHom] at key
   239	  -- key : `res f_i · res (f_j/f_i) = res f_j` on `O`; divide by the restricted unit
   240	  refine (Units.eq_inv_mul_iff_mul_eq
   241	    ((relCurve C R).unitsRestrict hO (A.eqnRatio i j))).mpr ?_
   242	  rw [mul_comm]
   243	  exact key
   244	
   245	/-- The matching condition of the equation components for the divisor datum, in the
   246	exact shape of the `gluedSubmodule` carrier at `W = ⊤` (adaptation-index form; each
   247	datum-index case is definitionally this statement). -/
   248	private lemma canon_matching (i j : A.index) :
   249	    (relCurve C R).resHom
   250	        (inf_le_left : ⊤ ⊓ A.pieces i ⊓ A.pieces j ≤ ⊤ ⊓ A.pieces i)
   251	        ((relCurve C R).resHom (inf_le_right : ⊤ ⊓ A.pieces i ≤ A.pieces i) (A.eqn i))
   252	      = (relCurve C R).resHom
   253	          (le_inf (inf_le_left.trans inf_le_right) inf_le_right :
   254	            ⊤ ⊓ A.pieces i ⊓ A.pieces j ≤ A.pieces i ⊓ A.pieces j)
   255	          (((A.thetaIdealUnit 0 i j)⁻¹ :
   256	              Γ(relCurve C R, A.pieces i ⊓ A.pieces j)ˣ) :
   257	            Γ(relCurve C R, A.pieces i ⊓ A.pieces j))
   258	        * (relCurve C R).resHom
   259	            (le_inf (inf_le_left.trans inf_le_left) inf_le_right :
   260	              ⊤ ⊓ A.pieces i ⊓ A.pieces j ≤ ⊤ ⊓ A.pieces j)
   261	            ((relCurve C R).resHom (inf_le_right : ⊤ ⊓ A.pieces j ≤ A.pieces j)
   262	              (A.eqn j)) := by
   263	  rw [A.thetaIdealUnit_zero i j]
   264	  have key := A.res_eqn_eq_inv_eqnRatio_mul i j
   265	    (O := ⊤ ⊓ A.pieces i ⊓ A.pieces j)
   266	    (le_inf (inf_le_left.trans inf_le_right) inf_le_right)
   267	  simp only [Scheme.resHom_resHom]
   268	  exact key
   269	
   270	/-- **The canonical section of the divisor datum is the equation system itself**
   271	(worksheet §2 (N2)): the components `A.eqn j`, restricted to the pieces, form a
   272	matching family for the inverted ratio units — a global section of the divisor
   273	datum's glued sheaf. -/
   274	noncomputable def canonSection :
   275	    ↥(_root_.AlgebraicGeometry.gluedSubmodule R A.divisorDatum.pieces
   276	        A.divisorDatum.unit ⊤) :=
   277	  ⟨fun j => (relCurve C R).resHom
   278	      (inf_le_right.trans (le_of_eq (A.thetaIdealDatum_pieces 0 j)))
   279	      (A.eqn (A.lowerIndex 0 j)),
   280	    by
   281	      intro i j
   282	      rcases i with i | i <;> rcases j with j | j
   283	      · exact A.canon_matching (Sum.inl i.down) (Sum.inl j.down)
   284	      · exact A.canon_matching (Sum.inl i.down) (Sum.inr j.down)
   285	      · exact A.canon_matching (Sum.inr i.down) (Sum.inl j.down)
   286	      · exact A.canon_matching (Sum.inr i.down) (Sum.inr j.down)⟩
   287	
   288	/-- The components of the canonical section are the (piece-restricted) equations. -/
   289	lemma component_canonSection (j : (A.thetaIdealDatum 0).index) :
   290	    A.divisorDatum.component A.canonSection j
   291	      = (relCurve C R).resHom (le_of_eq (A.thetaIdealDatum_pieces 0 j))
   292	          (A.eqn (A.lowerIndex 0 j)) :=
   293	  Scheme.resHom_resHom _ _ _
   294	
   295	/-- The canonical section is germ-regular: its components are the adaptation's own
   296	regular equations (`eqn_regular`) — the `hreg` input of `sectionLocalEquations`,
   297	with no fibrewise hypothesis. -/
   298	theorem germ_component_canonSection_mem_nonZeroDivisors
   299	    (j : (A.thetaIdealDatum 0).index) (y : relCurve C R)
   300	    (hy : y ∈ A.divisorDatum.pieces j) :
   301	    ((relCurve C R).presheaf.germ (A.divisorDatum.pieces j) y hy).hom
   302	        (A.divisorDatum.component A.canonSection j)
   303	      ∈ nonZeroDivisors ((relCurve C R).presheaf.stalk y) := by
   304	  have hy' : y ∈ A.pieces (A.lowerIndex 0 j) :=
   305	    (le_of_eq (A.thetaIdealDatum_pieces 0 j)) hy
   306	  have hswap : ((relCurve C R).presheaf.germ (A.divisorDatum.pieces j) y hy).hom
   307	      (A.divisorDatum.component A.canonSection j)
   308	      = ((relCurve C R).presheaf.germ (A.pieces (A.lowerIndex 0 j)) y hy').hom
   309	          (A.eqn (A.lowerIndex 0 j)) := by
   310	    rw [A.component_canonSection j]
   311	    exact TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply _ _ _ _ _
   312	  rw [hswap]
   313	  exact A.eqn_regular (A.lowerIndex 0 j) y hy'
   314	
   315	/-- **(N2) — the canonical section cuts back `d` by pure refinement**: the
   316	`LocalEquations` datum cut by the canonical section on any pointed cover subordinated
   317	to the pieces is `DivEq` to `d`. The common refinement is `𝒲 ⊓ d.cover`, and the
   318	comparison units are the adaptation's own `eqn_rel` units (`relUnit`) — no fibre
   319	argument anywhere. -/
   320	theorem divEq_sectionLocalEquations_canonSection
   321	    (𝒲 : (relCurve C R).PointedCover) (σ : relCurve C R → (A.thetaIdealDatum 0).index)
   322	    (hσ : ∀ y : relCurve C R, 𝒲.opens y ≤ A.divisorDatum.pieces (σ y)) :
   323	    Scheme.LocalEquations.DivEq
   324	      (A.divisorDatum.sectionLocalEquations A.canonSection 𝒲 σ hσ
   325	        (fun j y hy => A.germ_component_canonSection_mem_nonZeroDivisors j y hy))
   326	      d := by
   327	  refine ⟨𝒲 ⊓ d.cover, fun x => inf_le_left, fun x => inf_le_right, fun x => ?_⟩
   328	  -- the piece through `x` sits inside the adaptation piece of its lowered index
   329	  have hpc : 𝒲.opens x ≤ A.pieces (A.lowerIndex 0 (σ x)) :=
   330	    (hσ x).trans (le_of_eq (A.thetaIdealDatum_pieces 0 (σ x)))
   331	  have hle : 𝒲.opens x ⊓ d.cover.opens x
   332	      ≤ A.pieces (A.lowerIndex 0 (σ x)) ⊓ d.cover.opens x :=
   333	    inf_le_inf_right _ hpc
   334	  refine ⟨(relCurve C R).unitsRestrict hle (A.relUnit (A.lowerIndex 0 (σ x)) x), ?_⟩
   335	  -- the defining equation of the comparison unit, restricted to the refinement
   336	  have key := congrArg ((relCurve C R).resHom hle)
   337	    (A.res_eqn_eq_relUnit_mul (A.lowerIndex 0 (σ x)) x)
   338	  rw [map_mul] at key
   339	  simp only [Scheme.resHom_resHom] at key
   340	  -- collapse the constructed datum's restricted equation onto the adaptation
   341	  -- equation, term-mode (`rw` walks into the relCurve spelling seam — I-0237(a))
   342	  have hlhs := (Scheme.resHom_resHom (hσ x)
   343	      (inf_le_left : 𝒲.opens x ⊓ d.cover.opens x ≤ 𝒲.opens x)
   344	      (A.divisorDatum.component A.canonSection (σ x))).trans
   345	    ((congrArg ((relCurve C R).resHom
   346	        ((inf_le_left : 𝒲.opens x ⊓ d.cover.opens x ≤ 𝒲.opens x).trans (hσ x)))
   347	      (A.component_canonSection (σ x))).trans
   348	      (Scheme.resHom_resHom (le_of_eq (A.thetaIdealDatum_pieces 0 (σ x)))
   349	        ((inf_le_left : 𝒲.opens x ⊓ d.cover.opens x ≤ 𝒲.opens x).trans (hσ x))
   350	        (A.eqn (A.lowerIndex 0 (σ x)))))
   351	  exact hlhs.trans key

   353	end DivisorAdaptation
